sentence: This project builds a computer tool that finds somatic mutations of all types, lengths, and allele frequencies in healthy humans.
This project uses robotics, neuroimaging, and non-invasive brain stimulation to try to correct reward processes in the brain that sustain substance use disorders.
This project studies how human islets are formed, to help make them from human stem cells for diabetes therapy.
This project tries to find out how a defect in DNA repair works in Ewing sarcoma cells and whether targeted therapies can exploit it.
This project adapts and tests an asset-based economic empowerment intervention to improve HIV prevention and care among people facing economic hardship.
This project manages, shares, and analyzes data to help researchers understand the causes of metabolic dysfunction and diabetes linked to exposure.
This project tracks cannabis use in pregnant women and studies infant outcomes using brain imaging and behavioral measures.
This project tries to find out how changes in retinoic acid metabolism and receptors stop intestinal stem cells from differentiating.
This project evaluates smoking treatment programs in cancer centers to find effective ones that help cancer patients quit smoking.
This project studies how mitochondria differ between cell types as autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease progresses.
This project tries to find out how signaling from a mitochondrial protein controls hemoglobin synthesis in iron-deficient red blood cells.
This project uses mouse models of colorectal cancer to test whether raising a transcriptional co-activator in cancer cells slows tumor growth with radiotherapy and immunotherapy.
This project studies whether chromatin deformation controls how pluripotent stem cells differentiate and how normal stem cells differ from cancer stem cells.
This project tests a specific target for a non-narcotic therapeutic strategy to speed the resolution of inflammation and treat surgical or inflammatory pain.
This project develops bioinformatics software for quantitative analysis of the transcriptome from long-read sequencing, including gene isoform expression in single cells.
This project resolves full-length structures of human epidermal growth factor receptors to learn how they relay signals across the plasma membrane.
This project builds a cell-based assay platform to help scientists test drugs for metastatic breast cancer.
This project develops label-free optical imaging methods that detect changes in structure, molecular composition, metabolism, and function without a contrast agent or probe.
This project uses brain imaging to find which brain mechanisms are linked to depressive symptoms in adolescents with autism spectrum disorder.
This project tries to find evidence-based targets for continuous glucose monitoring that go with the lowest risk of diabetes complications in adults with type 1 diabetes.
